description: This PHP source file manages updating test case versions linked to test plans within the TestLink open source testing management system. It includes functions for processing test cases, test suites, and test plans, as well as updating test case versions and handling user interface logic.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for various data structures within the script.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments from the request and session for processing test plan updates.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs updates on selected test case versions within a test plan.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state object with default values and configuration.

methods.name: processTestSuite
methods.description: Processes and filters test suite data for display.

methods.name: doUpdateAllToLatest
methods.description: Updates all linked test case versions in a test plan to their latest versions.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Processes individual test case data for display and update.

methods.name: processTestPlan
methods.description: Processes and retrieves information about test plan linked test cases and their latest versions.

methods.name: tideUpForGUI
methods.description: Adjusts test suite and test case data structures for GUI display, including update eligibility.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing test plan planning features.
